title: Connection composer
description: Match process boundary, transport behavior, and negotiated capability surface to one workload.

workloads.label: Local repository assistant
workloads.detail: One desktop host launches a version-pinned process that reads project files and proposes bounded edits.
workloads.risk: Host must sandbox filesystem and process privileges.

workloads.label: Shared knowledge service
workloads.detail: Many authenticated workspaces read tenant-scoped documents from a centrally operated server.
workloads.risk: Server must isolate tenants and validate token audience on every request.

workloads.label: Durable automation service
workloads.detail: A remote server starts long-running export jobs and lets the host poll, inspect, or cancel them.
workloads.risk: Task support is experimental in this revision and requires explicit negotiation.

transports.label: stdio subprocess
transports.detail: The host owns process launch and exchanges newline-delimited JSON-RPC over standard input and output.
transports.authenticationModel: Credentials from a constrained process environment
safeguards: Keep logs on stderr, never stdout.
Pin the executable and verify its provenance.
Restrict filesystem, environment, and network access.

transports.label: Streamable HTTP
transports.detail: An independently operated server exposes one MCP endpoint using POST and GET with optional SSE.
transports.authenticationModel: OAuth resource-server authorization for protected deployments
safeguards: Validate Origin and reject invalid values with HTTP 403.
Validate issuer, audience, expiry, signature, and scope.
Bind local-only servers to localhost rather than all interfaces.

profiles.label: Read-only context
profiles.detail: Expose addressable data and reusable user-selected prompts.

profiles.label: Repository assistant
profiles.detail: Read project resources and offer schema-bounded operations.

profiles.label: Durable tool execution
profiles.detail: Expose tools and negotiate experimental task-augmented calls.

profiles.label: Every server feature
profiles.detail: Advertise resources, prompts, tools, and tasks whether the workload needs them or not.
